about_the_game:
Good Dreams is a game where you control a young girl who has gone on a trip to the countryside, landing in a secluded country house in the city. During your sleep, you wake up with unusual events happening, figure out a way to get everything back to normal, or if not, you'll never get out of this nightmare.

Use various items and discover various events that can help you on this journey, survive while everything around you tries to kill you. Even if all seems lost, there will still be a light at the end of the tunnel!

About the Demo:

Good Dreams Demo features 70% of the complete game map, also has less variety of items, actions on the map, and mobs, and contains only one achievable ending. The demo already includes the dynamics of action choices based on playtime and their outcomes.

Features

  • Survival, exploration and investigation

  • Events and choices, non-linear gameplay

  • Multiple endings to explore

  • Race against time

  • Puzzles
